M1: Asp + Val: pH 12 because Asp will be $-\text{CH}_2\text{COO}^{-}$ (R-group) moves further (to positive electrode than Val) or pH 12 Asp more negative so moves further (to positive electrode) or pH 12 because Asp has a charge of $2-$ but Val has a charge of $1-$ or best at pH 7 because Asp will be negatively charged (anionic) but Val neutral

M1: Lys + Ser: pH 2 because Lys will be $(\text{CH}_2)_4\text{NH}_3^{+}$ (R-group) moves further (to negative electrode than Ser) or pH 2 Lys more positive so moves further (to negative electrode) or pH 2 because Lys has a charge of $2+$ and Ser has a charge of $1+$ or pH 7 because Lys is positively charged (cationic) but Ser neutral / zwitterionic

Tyr + Phe: pH 12 because Tyr will be $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_2\text{O}^-$ (R-group) moves further / more / faster (to positive electrode than Phe) OR pH 12 because Tyr has a charge of 2- but Phe has a charge of 1- ;
